{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored trousers, straight leg, full length to the ankle, charcoal grey #3E4147, wool-blend twill

Fine-knit sweater, fitted crew neck, hip length, deep burgundy #6B2D3C, merino wool

Cardigan-style textured blazer, single-breasted, hip length, warm camel #B58B5E, wool bouclé

Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, dark brown #4A3326, polished leather

Belt, slim, with a small gold buckle, dark brown #4A3326, smooth leather

Tote bag, structured, medium size, cognac #8F5A32, grained leather

Thin gold hoop earrings, small, #C9A227, polished metal

Why this outfit works: It sits squarely in neat office dress, pairing a refined knit and tailored trousers with a textured jacket and loafers. The burgundy, camel and charcoal feel rich and seasonal for autumn, and the warm browns tie the shoes, belt and bag together. The bouclé jacket gives a light layer of warmth for a cool autumn commute while adding texture, and the whole look stays comfortable enough for a full day at work."}
